cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Make It Their Idea
cards.instruction: Make an unwanted task sound appealing enough that someone volunteers for it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll have these eighty wedding cards finished tonight. Your lettering would make them worth keeping; would you take the pen?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I like lettering. I don't want to copy a guest list all evening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll read every name to you. You can make each card look exactly as you like.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Even purple? Your aunt will make you ask me to change it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Purple is now my color scheme. I'll tell her that before she sees them. Will you start with her name while I read it out?

reason: Make A confidently promise completion dependent on B voluntary pen, then absorb B color risk into A official scheme and renew a specific inviting task request.
